original_fields.Title: Discontinued Criminal conviction and sentencing statistics: June 2025 fiscal year - note
original_fields.Content:
11 September 2026: Stats NZ will no longer publish the fiscal year (year ended 30 June) release for Criminal conviction and sentencing statistics. 

Stats NZ will continue to publish calendar year (year ended 31 December) releases of these statistics.

Similar statistics will continue to be available through the Ministry of Justice’s Data tables.

Stats NZ is modernising the way we collect, process, and produce official data and statistics, to support a more efficient and sustainable data system.

More information: info@stats.govt.nz.

original_fields.Title: Description criminal conviction and sentencing statistics (fiscal and calendar year)
original_fields.Content: Criminal conviction and sentencing statistics include tables about convictions, prosecutions, and charges by offence type, sentence type, and most serious offence. This data is provided to us by the Ministry of Justice.
